title: Not sure it’s worth the effort but I’m happy with it
text: Not sure it’s worth the effort but I’m happy with it. If you don’t mind a little extra work this isn’t a bad item. BUT BEWARE... the result you see in my photo is after about 8 hours of working on it solo. I added a liner to the back wall. You might be able to notice that the drawer is off. It was crooked and misaligned. The drawer wouldn’t close. I had to redrill the holes for it. I also wasn’t able to put on the doors right away because that hardware was missing. The company was speedy in mailing the part to me without charge but I had to email them and wait about a week. Amazon gave me a 50 percent discount but I was on hold and/or talking to someone for about 25 minutes. It was annoying but I do like the finished product. Oh, I’d also suggest getting new wheels the cheap plastic ones that come with it were crap and I have hardwood floors which should be easy for rolling. I upgraded with a $15 set of wheels from Amazon that are great. If you aren’t handy enough to fix the potential problems, I wouldn’t suggest this, if you are and you will follow through to get missing parts and talk to Amazon about a discount potentially, and you have the need for an inexpensive island and some extra time to build it, go for it.
